grades.lower_bound_mechanism: stabilisation of minimal hitting sets / finiteness of core primes (Lemma 1-2, sketched)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: valid set as union of APs mod L, greedy enumeration additively periodic with T=count per window
grades.notes: Restates the problem as eventual periodicity (with preperiod N_0) and proves only that weaker statement; periodicity from n=1 is not established. Hitting-set characterization and V=union of APs, L=product of core primes, T=residue count are explicit. But finiteness/stabilisation (Lemma 1) is admittedly sketched, transient-term claim merely asserted, Section 5 classification incomplete with '?' cases.
